title: Two-day Machu Picchu tour with private guide

description.text: Enjoy a complete Machu Picchu experience with a 2-day itinerary, allowing you to explore Circuit 2 and Circuit 3 in a single day with a fluent English-speaking private guide. Discover the classic panoramic views, important temples, sacred plazas and the most iconic archaeological sites of the Inca citadel.

Your experience includes assistance at the Machu Picchu train station, transfer to your hotel, support with organizing your Circuit 2 ticket, round-trip Consettur bus transportation between Machu Picchu Pueblo and the Sanctuary, and personalized assistance throughout your visit.

items: Reception at the Machu Picchu train station by a representative holding a sign with the traveler's name, and transfer to the hotel.
Board the Consettur bus from Machu Picchu Pueblo to the Sanctuary.

5-hour tour with a private guide visiting the highlights of Circuit 2 and Circuit 3 (Panoramic Viewpoint, Guardian's House, Temple of the Sun, Main Temple, Temple of the Three Windows, Intihuatana Pyramid, Sacred Rock, Temple of the Condor, among others).
Return by Consettur bus to Machu Picchu Pueblo, ending at the initial meeting point.

paragraphs.text: Places and attractions visited during the 5-hour excursion:

items: Classic panoramic viewpoint (Classic panoramic view of Machu Picchu)
Sacred Plaza / Plaza of the Temples
Private guide fluent in English for Circuit 2 and Circuit 3
Machu Picchu entrance tickets (Circuit 2 and Circuit 3)
Assistance at the Machu Picchu train station, transfer to hotel
Consettur bus tickets (round-trip: Machu Picchu Pueblo – Sanctuary)
Allowed age: From 3 to 68 years old.
Duration: 5 hours. Start time subject to availability.
Available in languages: Spanish and English.

Meeting point/pick-up: Upon arrival at the Machu Picchu train station (KM 110), Ca. Contisuyo, Aguas Calientes, you will be greeted by a representative holding a sign with the first and last name of the main traveler. Pick-up is offered at selected hotels.
The activity ends at the initial meeting point.

Accessibility and health: Not wheelchair accessible. Public transportation nearby. Babies must sit on a lap. Not recommended for travelers with back problems, pregnant women, or those with heart conditions or other serious medical issues. Medium fitness level required.

Ticket issuance and booking information: The Circuit 3B entrance will be provided 4 days before your visit date. Subsequently, the in-person purchase process for Circuit 2 will proceed at the official ticket office in Machu Picchu Pueblo, subject to availability.

Mandatory passport requirement: To issue your tickets, you must send a clear photo of the passport with visible and legible information to reservas@chullpiexpeditions.com or via WhatsApp at +51 940 468 520.
